panel.title: Automation
panel.stop_all_tooltip: Stop all: stops every automation and cancels any movement, teleport or action in progress.
panel.pause_tooltip: Pause: stops moving and acting but keeps the progress. Resume later to continue with the spots not visited yet (the route is re-planned from where you are).
panel.resume_tooltip: Resume: re-plan from where you are and continue with the spots not visited yet ({progress} visited). To start over instead, press Stop first to discard the progress.
panel.start_fresh_tooltip: Press to start from the beginning (discards the kept progress, {progress} visited).
panel.stop_discard_tooltip: Stop and discard the progress. To continue later, use Pause instead.
panel.death_restore_tooltip: Restore the automation that stopped when you were KO'd: each one starts with the usual checks; treasure and carrot hunts resume from the kept progress. Anything that cannot start says why in chat.
panel.combo_start_tooltip:
Start your usual combo in one go: {names}.
Anything already running is left alone; each one can still be started / stopped on its own, and Stop All and the emergency stop still stop everything.
Pick what the combo contains in the Illegal Mode settings.
panel.combo_stop_tooltip:
Stop what is in your usual combo: {names}.
Only these stop; other automation keeps running.

kind.phantom_job_leveling: Phantom job leveling (switch to the next unmaxed phantom job once the current one is maxed)

resume_blocked.none: There is no paused progress to resume.
resume_blocked.zone_changed: You changed zones or left Occult Crescent since pausing, so the chests and carrots are not the same set any more. Press Start to run from the beginning.
resume_blocked.logged_out: You logged out or disconnected since pausing. Press Start to run from the beginning.

skip.label: Skipped
skip.tooltip:
Switch: skip the event Illegal Mode has currently picked. Illegal Mode keeps running and picks the next one right away; with nothing else to join it idles as usual.
If you are already inside its area, inside the Critical Engagement or in combat, BOCCHI does not take you out: it picks the next one once you leave the area, it ends, or combat ends.
Skipped events are listed below under Skipped and can be cleared; an entry drops off by itself when that event ends, on a zone change or on logout.
skip.clear_tooltip: Clear the skipped list: these events can be picked again.
skip.blocked_no_activity: No event is picked right now (idle).
skip.blocked_pot_wait: Currently waiting at a pot spawn point for it to appear; that is not an event, so there is nothing to skip.

combo.empty: Nothing is ticked in the usual combo: tick some in the Illegal Mode settings.
combo.conflict: {names} in the combo all move the character and cannot run together: keep only one ticked in the Illegal Mode settings.
combo.all_running: Everything in the combo is already running.
